title: TOEIC® Listening - Versión 1: Meetings & CRM Transition
description: Prueba intensiva de comprensión auditiva TOEIC® enfocada en el contexto de Zenith Corp con the Sales Director.

parts.visual:
## 📸 Simulación de Auditiva: Zenith Corp

Evaluaremos tu destreza auditiva en el contexto de **Zenith Corp** (Líder a cargo: **the Sales Director**).

Concéntrate plenamente en las descripciones y los audios corporativos.
parts.audio: Welcome to this specialized TOEIC Listening drill. Listen closely to the speaker options and pick the best description of the workspace. Good luck!

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTOGRAPH]: Look at the business picture of Zenith Corp's office staff. Select the correct description.
questions.audio_script: A) They are discussing the CRM dashboard. B) They are leaving the main lobby. C) The server room is closed. D) They are filing paper documents.
questions.explanation: La descripción correcta es la A, ya que se observa a los representantes analizando el panel del CRM.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the conversation and answer: What is the main issue discussed by the speakers?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi Sarah, did you get a chance to review the shipment contract from Zenith Corp?
W: I did. Their pricing is competitive, but their delivery window is too narrow for our schedule.
M: I see. I will call the Sales Director to negotiate an extension.
options: The contract pricing is too high.
The delivery window is too narrow for their schedule.
They want to cancel the shipment.
The company wants to buy ApexCRM.
questions.correct_answer: The delivery window is too narrow for their schedule.
questions.explanation: La mujer menciona explícitamente: 'pricing is competitive, but their delivery window is too narrow for our schedule'.
